title: it can not dump process memory
body:
[*] Enter receiver IP: 192.168.1.123
[*] Enter receiver port: 123
[+] Process lsass.exe found with PID 768
[!] Failed to dump process memory.
author: peyman13

comments.body:
Hey,
The dump is likely failing because lsass.exe is protected by Windows (PPL). You have to run the exe with the SYSTEM permissions — that should bypass the protection and allow the dump to work.
